task.text: A request has many optional parts and some illegal combinations. Make a **builder** that only produces valid, immutable requests.
`HttpRequest` is a record; `HttpRequest.builder(String uri)` returns its nested `Builder`. Fill in the signatures already declared in `HttpRequest.java`:

items: `method`, `header(name, value)` (repeatable, call order kept), `body` and `timeout` all return the builder.
Defaults: method `GET`, timeout 30 seconds, no headers, no body.
`build()` throws `IllegalStateException` for a `GET` with a body, a missing or non-positive timeout, or a blank URI.
Products never change afterwards: not through the builder, not through `headers()`.
The builder can be reused: each `build()` gives an equal, independent request.

checks.title: A GET with a body is rejected
Zero or negative timeouts are rejected
A blank URI is rejected by build()
A builder can build twice, independently
Later builder calls cannot change a product

hints.text: Collect the parts one at a time in a mutable helper, validate everything once at the end, and only then create the immutable product.

`Builder` keeps fields with the defaults and a `List<Header>`. Each setter assigns and returns `this`. `build()` validates, then calls the record constructor. Copy the list in the record's compact constructor.
Copy on the way into the product:

lines: record HttpRequest(String method, String uri, List<Header> headers,
